name: 18088-mtpchat-qwen3next80b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, unquantized. Cached locally; nothing downloads.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism and no DP attention. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, 48 layers, hidden 2048, vocab 151936; sparse MoE (512 routed experts at top-10 plus one shared) with hybrid attention; the checkpoint ships its own multi-token-prediction draft head, so no second model is fetched. ~160 GB of bf16 weights, ~20 GB per rank at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 480 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `huggingface`, HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k split test_sft -- real single-turn chat instructions. Output is pinned: max_tokens 512, ignore_eos true, temperature 0.0.
purpose: A general chat assistant on an eight-GPU node, built-in draft head, 48 concurrent streams, 512-token replies.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang, `sglang serve` CLI form.
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 8

# `NEXTN` is normalised to EAGLE against the checkpoint's own draft head in server_args.py.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 4
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 5

# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit heuristic, which derives a different pool per
# process from whatever is free.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 0

# Left unset on purpose, because the engine derives the operating point from them:
#   max-running-requests   -- the engine resets it to 48 under any speculative algorithm.
#   max-mamba-cache-size   -- model_runner takes max_num_reqs = min(max_num_reqs,
#                             max_mamba_cache_size // 3), so a hand-set value silently
#                             lowers the running batch below 48.
#   mamba-scheduler-strategy -- "auto", which this version resolves to "no_buffer".
#   attention-backend, chunked-prefill-size -- engine defaults for this config.
#   dtype / quantization   -- the checkpoint is bf16 and declares neither.
#   host / port / served-model-name -- supplied at launch.
